headline: Heavy Fighting Reopens Divided Fronts
war_summary: The latest ledger puts WeatheredExpanseHex at the head of the movement column, with fifteen base events in twenty-four hours and four in the latest two; its nine-base front remains divided five Warden to four Colonial, while casualties and enlistments are both active. StonecradleHex has climbed to eighteen daily events, though none are recorded in the latest six hours. Its line now shows six Colonial bases and three Warden, with no neutral holdings, amid sharply accelerating losses on both sides. StlicanShelfHex has also quickened, recording seven events in the day and three in six hours; the balance remains close at five Warden to four Colonial. LinnMercyHex, formerly the busiest ledger, stands at nineteen daily events, with one in six hours and the latest recorded turnover at 06:15 UTC; all eleven bases currently report Colonial ownership. FarranacCoastHex remains active at five daily events, with two Warden bases against nine Colonial. MooringCountyHex records two events and a heavily lopsided eleven-to-one Warden-Colonial count. Most other regions show no recent base movement, leaving these divided or recently shifting fronts the chief watch points.
